parts.t: Delta says the area east of Highway 17A is often called East Ladner. It has farmland and some early community buildings on Ladner Trunk Road.

Written by Jared Gibbons, REALTOR®, Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, on October 11, 2026. I have worked in Lower Mainland real estate for 11+ years. Facts come from the official sources noted on this page. Rules and boundaries change, so confirm anything important with the City of Delta.
Not legal, planning or financial advice. Confirm zoning, plan designations and school catchments before you buy or sell.

Is there an official East Delta boundary?
East Delta is an MLS® sub-area name used by the real estate board rather than an official municipal boundary, so ask me to verify any specific address.
Much of Delta is. The ALR is about 9,000 hectares, around half of Delta’s land. ALR status is set property by property, so check the exact address on the
What heritage sites are on Ladner Trunk Road?
East Delta Hall (10379), St. Stephen’s Church (9696) and Butler’s Corner (9581) are marked in Delta’s heritage materials.
Elementary catchment across rural East Delta depends on the exact road and address. Delta Secondary at 4615 51 Street is the secondary school in Ladner. Check the
Is there a golf course in East Delta?
Delta Golf & Country Club is at 11550 Ladner Trunk Road and Kings Links by the Sea is at 3388 72 Street. Check each club for tee times and membership.
